<module id="multi_pipe_8bit">
    <description>Unsigned 8-bit multiplier using pipelining.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal used for synchronous operation.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Active-low reset signal. Defined as 0 for chip reset and 1 for reset signal inactive.</input>
        <input id="mul_en_in">Input enable signal that controls the multiplication operation.</input>
        <input id="mul_a" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplicand with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <input id="mul_b" width_description="[7:0]">Input signal representing the multiplier with a data width of 8 bits.</input>
        <output id="mul_en_out">Output enable signal indicating if the multiplication operation is enabled.</output>
        <output id="mul_out" width_description="[15:0]">Product output signal with a data width of 16 bits.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">8</parameter>
        <parameter id="PRODUCT_WIDTH">16</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <register id="mul_en_out_reg">
            <assign>
                <case>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && !rst_n">
                        0
                    </when>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && mul_en_in">
                        1
                    </when>
                    <default>
                        mul_en_out_reg
                    </default>
                </case>
            </assign>
        </register>
        <register id="mul_a_reg">
            <assign>
                <case>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && !rst_n">
                        0
                    </when>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && mul_en_in">
                        mul_a
                    </when>
                    <default>
                        mul_a_reg
                    </default>
                </case>
            </assign>
        </register>
        <register id="mul_b_reg">
            <assign>
                <case>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && !rst_n">
                        0
                    </when>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && mul_en_in">
                        mul_b
                    </when>
                    <default>
                        mul_b_reg
                    </default>
                </case>
            </assign>
        </register>
        <wire_array id="temp" size="WIDTH">
            <assign>
                <case>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && !rst_n">
                        0
                    </when>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && mul_en_in">
                        {temp[WIDTH-2:0], mul_a_reg & mul_b_reg[WIDTH-1]}
                    </when>
                    <default>
                        temp
                    </default>
                </case>
            </assign>
        </wire_array>
        <register_array id="sum" size="WIDTH+1">
            <assign>
                <case>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && !rst_n">
                        0
                    </when>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && mul_en_in">
                        sum[0] + temp[0]
                    </when>
                    <default>
                        sum
                    </default>
                </case>
            </assign>
        </register_array>
        <register id="mul_out_reg">
            <assign>
                <case>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && !rst_n">
                        0
                    </when>
                    <when condition="clk rising_edge && mul_en_in">
                        sum[WIDTH]
                    </when>
                    <default>
                        mul_out_reg
                    </default>
                </case>
            </assign>
        </register>
        <output id="mul_en_out">
            <assign>
                mul_en_out_reg[WIDTH-1]
            </assign>
        </output>
        <output id="mul_out">
            <assign>
                <case>
                    <when condition="mul_en_out_reg[WIDTH-1]">
                        mul_out_reg
                    </when>
                    <default>
                        0
                    </default>
                </case>
            </assign>
        </output>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>The module implements an 8-bit unsigned multiplier using pipelining. It includes input control, input registers, partial product generation, partial sum calculation, and final product calculation.</implementation>
</module>
